title: terraform(private): refactor state layout + add gpu_node_pool, iam and networking modules for private deployments
author: Olivia Chen
description: This PR refactors the Terraform state layout for private deployments and introduces consolidated modules for GPU node pools, IAM roles/service accounts, and VPC networking subnet allocations. Motivation: customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) with GPU workloads requested a clearer state separation per-environment and per-cluster, plus standardized GPU node pool defaults (taints, labels, instance mappings) and upgraded IAM artifacts for node bootstrap and CSI drivers. The state refactor also enables safe in-place upgrades for existing customers by providing a migration plan and opt-in migration scripts.
commits: feat: add module gpu_node_pool with taints, labels, autoscaler config and instance-type mapping
chore: move networking resources into module vpc_network with subnet allocation helpers
feat: add iam module for node roles, CSI and kms bindings
refactor: reorganize terraform state into env-scoped workspaces and per-cluster state files
docs: add migration guide and examples for upgrade path
test: add terratest cases for gpu_node_pool and vpc_network modules
fix: tighten IAM policy for node-bootstrap and remove wildcard permissions
ci: add plan checks for state-migration and guard rails
review_comments: Jae Park (reviewer): Please ensure the state migration path is reversible for customers who try and need to roll back. The script looks good but we need explicit rollback steps in the README.
Olivia Chen (author): Added rollback section and a sanity-check flow in state-layout/README.md; migration script will create a backup state file with timestamp before applying moves.

Marcus Liu (reviewer): IAM policy looks restrictive which is good, but CSI driver install requires iam:PassRole for the node-bootstrap SA. Add a narrowly scoped PassRole statement and document its usage.
Olivia Chen (author): Adjusted policies.tf to add iam:PassRole only for the exact service-account ARNs created by the module and added a note in module docs.
Priya Singh (reviewer): Terratest failures initially flaked in CI due to race conditions in subnet allocation tests. Can we add retries with exponential backoff?
Olivia Chen (author): Added retries in terratest helpers and increased timeout; re-ran CI after fixes.
Emma Rodriguez (reviewer): Small naming nit: prefer 'gpu_node_pool' over 'gpu-nodepool' in remote state key; updated references accordingly.
Olivia Chen (author): Renamed remote state keys and updated examples; confirmed no break to existing workspace names.
CI (comment): initial terraform plan check failed on unknown variable 'kms_key_arn' in examples - fixed by adding default and pointer in README.
ci_checks: ci/terraform-plan-check: fail (initial) - unknown variable in example
release_notes: Refactor Terraform state layout for private deployments; new gpu_node_pool, iam, and vpc_network modules. Includes migration script and examples. Backwards-compatible by default, opt-in migration required for existing customers.
migration_guide_snippet: Run state-layout/migrate_state.sh --from workspace-old --to env/cluster-name; script creates backups and prints verification steps. See state-layout/README.md for rollback instructions.
upgrade_instructions:
- Review example in examples/private-gpu/README.md
- Run terragrunt or terraform plan against new modules in a dry-run
- Use migrate_state.sh to move remote state if adopting env-scoped layout
- Contact SRE if you rely on custom remote state keys so we can assist with migration
notes: This PR was reviewed and approved after two rounds of changes. It consolidates a few previously scattered networking and IAM resources into modules that are easier to consume for Private deployments with GPUs. The migration path is intentionally opt-in.
